k3_stop_rules: Do not issue any local or reference model call under this K2 authority; a separate prospectively sealed K3 owner is required.
Stop before the first K3 call unless this producer and role-separated audit are both GREEN and byte-bound.
Stop on any candidate-visible field outside the four-field allowlist or any target-derived path, metadata, evaluator, test, answer, or decoder hint.
Stop on any source, task, evaluator, model, tokenizer, decoder, wrapper, route, arm, or policy identity drift; repair only under a new campaign identity.
Stop and invalidate the observation if the physical context boundary or host-safety interlock activates; never score it as model or subsystem failure.
Stop on write escape, broad-effect-root mismatch, failed independent candidate-integrity rederivation, or failed blind-evaluator custody.
Run every local arm to a complete artifact or model EOS with no project-selected generated-token quality cap; record actual prompt and generated tokens.
Keep tasks, arm packets, ordering policy, outcomes, and evaluator semantics frozen after the first call; never adapt them to observed results.
Omit Luna without blocking the local canary unless a prospective receipt proves the route is Codex-subscription-backed with zero API billing and no API credential path.
If a Luna route becomes eligible, seal it before the first local arm, use identical candidate-visible packets and hidden evaluators, and keep its outputs and costs in a separate denominator.
Treat the six-row K3 result only as an instrument and residual-exposure canary; it cannot support or falsify the VCM claim, select book support, or replace the powered source-disjoint campaign.
Stop after one complete matched pass across the frozen six rows; any rerun requires a predeclared invalidation class and a new campaign identity.
